SELECT 
  d, 
  date_trunc('WEEK', d) as dt_week, 
  date_trunc('WEEK', cast(d as date)) as dt_week_date,
  cast(date_trunc('WEEK', d) as date) as cast_date,
  dayofweek(d) as dow,
  date_sub(d, (dayofweek(d) + 5) % 7) as monday_sub
FROM (VALUES 
  (DATE '2026-08-03'), -- Monday
  (DATE '2026-08-04'), -- Tuesday
  (DATE '2026-08-09'), -- Sunday
  (DATE '2026-08-10')  -- Monday
) AS t(d)
SELECT trunc(DATE '2026-08-09', 'WEEK') as trunc_week
DESCRIBE SELECT trunc(DATE '2026-08-09', 'WEEK') as trunc_week

SELECT trunc(signup_date, 'WEEK') AS cohort_week, count(*) AS cohort_size
FROM workspace.exam_xff22c.signups

ORDER BY 1

SELECT 
  d,
  datediff(d, DATE '2026-08-03') as diff,
  floor(datediff(d, DATE '2026-08-03') / 7.0) as fl,
  datediff(d, DATE '2026-08-03') div 7 as dv
FROM (VALUES 
  (DATE '2026-08-02'),
  (DATE '2026-08-03'),
  (DATE '2026-08-09'),
  (DATE '2026-08-10'),
  (DATE '2026-08-16'),
  (DATE '2026-08-31')
) AS t(d)

SELECT 
  round(100.0 * 25 / 73, 1) as r1,
  round(100.0 * 0 / 73, 1) as r2,
  round(100.0 * 73 / 73, 1) as r3,
  typeof(round(100.0 * 25 / 73, 1)) as t1,
  cast(round(100.0 * 25 / 73, 1) as double) as t2

WITH user_activity_weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        s.user_id,
        trunc(s.signup_date, 'WEEK') AS cohort_week,
        floor(datediff(a.activity_date, s.signup_date) / 7.0) AS week_n
    FROM workspace.exam_xff22c.signups s
    JOIN workspace.exam_xff22c.activity a
      ON s.user_id = a.user_id
    WHERE a.activity_date >= s.signup_date
      AND floor(datediff(a.activity_date, s.signup_date) / 7.0) BETWEEN 0 AND 4
),
cohorts AS (
    SELECT 
        trunc(signup_date, 'WEEK') AS cohort_week,
        count(distinct user_id) AS cohort_size
    FROM workspace.exam_xff22c.signups
    GROUP BY 1
),
grid AS (
    SELECT c.cohort_week, c.cohort_size, w.week_n
    FROM cohorts c
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT explode(sequence(0, 4)) AS week_n) w
),
cohort_week_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        cohort_week,
        week_n,
        count(distinct user_id) AS active_users
    FROM user_activity_weeks
    GROUP BY cohort_week, week_n
)
SELECT 
    g.cohort_week,
    g.cohort_size,
    g.week_n,
    coalesce(cwc.active_users, 0) AS active_users,
    round(100.0 * coalesce(cwc.active_users, 0) / g.cohort_size, 1) AS retention_pct
FROM grid g
LEFT JOIN cohort_week_counts cwc
  ON g.cohort_week = cwc.cohort_week AND g.week_n = cwc.week_n
ORDER BY g.cohort_week, g.week_n

SELECT

WITH c_weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT date_sub(signup_date, (dayofweek(signup_date) + 5) % 7) AS cohort_week
    FROM workspace.exam_xff22c.signups
),
c_grid AS (
    SELECT c.cohort_week, w.week_n
    FROM c_weeks c
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT 0 AS week_n UNION ALL
        SELECT 1 UNION ALL
        SELECT 2 UNION ALL
        SELECT 3 UNION ALL
        SELECT 4
    ) w
),
c_sizes AS (
    SELECT date_sub(signup_date, (dayofweek(signup_date) + 5) % 7) AS cohort_week,
           count(distinct user_id) AS cohort_size
    FROM workspace.exam_xff22c.signups
    GROUP BY 1
),
c_active AS (
    SELECT 
        date_sub(s.signup_date, (dayofweek(s.signup_date) + 5) % 7) AS cohort_week,
        datediff(a.activity_date, s.signup_date) div 7 AS week_n,
        count(distinct s.user_id) AS active_users
    FROM workspace.exam_xff22c.signups s
    INNER JOIN workspace.exam_xff22c.activity a
        ON s.user_id = a.user_id
    WHERE a.activity_date >= s.signup_date
      AND datediff(a.activity_date, s.signup_date) < 35
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
expected AS (
    SELECT 
        g.cohort_week,
        s.cohort_size,
        g.week_n,
        coalesce(a.active_users, 0) AS active_users,
        round(100.0 * coalesce(a.active_users, 0) / s.cohort_size, 1) AS retention_pct
